title: A Study of Baricitinib in Participants From 1 Year to Less Than 18 Years Old With Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JUVE-X)
official: I4V-MC-JAHX: A Phase 3 Multicenter Study to Evaluate the Long-Term Safety and Efficacy of Baricitinib in Patients from 1 Year to <18 Years of Age with Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (JIA)
summary: Main objective: The reason for this study is to see if the study drug baricitinib is safe and effective in the treatment of JIA in participants ages 1 to 17
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Participants must have completed a previous study of baricitinib for the treatment of JIA
2. Participants must have not developed an allergy to baricitinib
Exclusion criteria:
1. Participants must not have permanently stopped baricitinib in the prior study
2. Participants must have not developed an allergy to baricitinib
